note: Plates: each entry groups isolated figures into one read plate. Edit, then run python3 _build/plates.py.

plates.title: Green screen-tone blooms
plates.lede: Four blooms printed as one green ink through a dot screen.

read.name: Dot-screen bloom
read.implementation: A scatter of marks is printed through a coarse dot screen; dot size carries the density, so the bloom fades at its edge without a gradient.

plates.title: Records in dots
plates.lede: A record drawn one dot per character, read seven ways.

read.name: One dot per character
read.implementation: Every character of a record is one dot; position comes from the model, tone from who wrote it.

plates.title: Rings on black
plates.lede: Rings of glowing dots on black, with the waves and chords under them.

read.name: Glowing dot ring
read.implementation: Dots on a ring are drawn with a soft halo on black; chords and waves sit under the ring as thin lines.

plates.title: Node rings on white
plates.lede: The same ring of nodes, from black ink to a thin blue net.

read.name: Node ring
read.implementation: Points on a ring are joined to their neighbors by straight edges; the edge count makes the weight of the ring.

plates.title: The helix step
plates.lede: A record as a staircase that turns, with a walker on it.

read.name: Steps on a helix
read.implementation: A record is laid out as steps that climb a helix; a figure, a crystal or a state marker stands on a step.

plates.title: Helix forms
plates.lede: One helix, drawn seven ways.

read.name: Helix by projection
read.implementation: One helix drawn as boxes, a single line, a cut ribbon, a wave and a ring seen down the axis.

plates.title: Counts as bars
plates.lede: Counts, states and areas drawn as plain bars.

read.name: Counts as bars
read.implementation: Counts are drawn as bars in two or three greens, with a dashed baseline for the expected value.

plates.title: Resonance patterns
plates.lede: Moiré, contour, tartan and plate figures from crossed periodic fields.

read.name: Interference figure
read.implementation: Two or more periodic fields are multiplied or summed; the figure is where they agree.

plates.title: Gradient cards and die-cuts
plates.lede: Cards cut to arches, steps and notches, each filled with a soft gradient.

read.name: Die-cut gradient card
read.implementation: A soft multi-stop gradient fills a card cut to an arch, a step or a notch; a large number sits in the cut.

plates.title: Garden, atlas, agenda, sphere
plates.lede: Seven entries drawn as a garden, a map, an agenda and a sphere.

read.name: One record, four views
read.implementation: The same seven entries drawn as a planted plot, a route map, a timed agenda and a sphere of addresses.

plates.title: Signal cards
plates.lede: Cards that each carry one field and one word.

read.name: Signal card
read.implementation: A field of dots or lines is set behind one word and a small arrow; the field carries the meaning of the word.

plates.title: Fields of characters
plates.lede: Letters and marks laid out as fields.

read.name: Character field
read.implementation: Characters are placed as a field: a spiral of letters, an ellipse of marks.

plates.title: Constructions in perspective
plates.lede: A one-point stair and an isometric stack.

read.name: Projected construction
read.implementation: Planes and stairs are drawn in one-point or isometric projection with hard flat color.

plates.title: River and riverbed
plates.lede: A river and its banks drawn as tiles.

read.name: Pixel river
read.implementation: A river drawn as tiles: water, banks and stones as flat pixel color.

plates.title: Pico carrier schematics
plates.lede: Circuit and timing drawings for a microcontroller board.

read.name: Circuit schematic
read.implementation: Parts are boxes on a grid; wires run square; one accent color marks the live line.

plates.title: Leaders, frames and tags
plates.lede: Rules for frames, leaders and tags, drawn as examples.

read.name: Leader and tag
read.implementation: A frame, a leader line that bends once and a numbered tag; the rules for each are drawn as the example.

plates.title: Diagrams of a reading, I
plates.lede: Diagrams that draw an argument, one claim each.

read.name: Diagram of an argument
read.implementation: Each claim of the text is drawn as boxes, poles and arrows on a white sheet with a numbered caption.

plates.title: Diagrams of a reading, II
plates.lede: Diagrams that draw an argument, one claim each.

read.name: Diagram of an argument
read.implementation: Each claim of the text is drawn as boxes, poles and arrows on a white sheet with a numbered caption.

plates.title: Desktop Bo, states and scenes
plates.lede: A desktop pet: its states, its frames and its yard.

read.name: Sprite states
read.implementation: A character is drawn as a set of states around an idle hub and placed into scenes.

plates.title: MASSIVE fields and counts
plates.lede: A field bent by wells, a lattice and a count per day.

read.name: Field model
read.implementation: Points move in a field bent by wells; counts per day sit beside it as a line.

plates.title: The park and its buildings
plates.lede: A park and two buildings as isometric sprites.

read.name: Isometric sprite
read.implementation: Buildings and a park drawn as isometric pixel sprites, roof on and roof off.

plates.title: Cathode-ray receivers
plates.lede: Five televisions drawn in one gray line.

read.name: Product line drawing
read.implementation: A television drawn in a single gray line, front and three-quarter, with no fill.

plates.title: Keyline and ink, texture and color
plates.lede: Flat shapes in a keyline with printed texture.

read.name: Keyline with texture
read.implementation: Flat shapes inside a keyline, with a printed texture laid into each shape.

plates.title: Keyline and ink, type
plates.lede: Condensed capitals in flat color.

read.name: Condensed display type
read.implementation: Condensed capitals set tight in two or three flat colors.

plates.title: Keyline and ink, assembly
plates.lede: Finished sheets: type, flowers and frames in a few inks.

read.name: Keyline assembly
read.implementation: Type, a botanical figure and a frame assembled into one sheet in three or four inks.

plates.title: Orthographic subjects
plates.lede: Orthographic drawings of two objects and their sources.

read.name: Orthographic set
read.implementation: A subject drawn front, side and top in thin line, with its sources beside it.

plates.title: Bar charts in gold and black
plates.lede: Two ranked bar charts in gold, black and gray.

read.name: Ranked bars
read.implementation: Bars ranked longest to shortest in gold, black and gray, one color per intent.

plates.title: Soft focus, experiments
plates.lede: Plum blossoms, lights and bokeh, from sharp to soft.

read.name: Soft-focus field
read.implementation: Flowers and lights drawn in sharp line and then softened: blur, glow and bokeh over a flat ground.

plates.title: Soft focus, type and finals
plates.lede: Soft fields under crisp type and one sharp subject.

read.name: Soft focus with type
read.implementation: A soft field set behind or around crisp type and a single sharp subject.

plates.title: Line and wash
plates.lede: A fern and an apricot in line, wash and dots.

read.name: Line and wash
read.implementation: A drawn outline over a flat wash or a dot screen, each object on white.

plates.title: Optics, markers and plates
plates.lede: Rays, markers and one color plate from crystal optics.

read.name: Ray trace
read.implementation: Rays and markers traced through a crystal model on black, with a color plate beside them.

plates.title: The garden drawn
plates.lede: The garden as a bed, a plan, a drawing and a sheet.

read.name: Garden as drawing
read.implementation: The garden drawn as a bed, a plan, an ink drawing and a sheet.

plates.title: The cave rig
plates.lede: A projection rig in plan and elevation.

read.name: Rig plan
read.implementation: A wall, a turntable and a projector drawn in plan and in elevation.

plates.title: How a moth works, I
plates.lede: A moth, its warmth and its hearing, drawn as plates.

read.name: Field-guide plate
read.implementation: A specimen drawn in color on black, with charts and measurements set around it.

plates.title: How a moth works, II
plates.lede: Light, color and the Io moth, drawn as plates.

read.name: Field-guide plate
read.implementation: A specimen drawn in color on black, with charts and measurements set around it.

plates.title: Information, drawn
plates.lede: A wire diagram and three curves from information theory.

read.name: Information chart
read.implementation: A wire diagram and three curves: entropy, capacity and the Shannon limit.

plates.title: Weighed
plates.lede: A scale, an envelope and a stamp in flat color.

read.name: Measured drawing
read.implementation: A scale, an envelope and a stamp drawn in flat color from measured proportions.

plates.title: Counted fields
plates.lede: Tone set as a count of single dots, in a dark green and a teal on white.

read.name: Counted stipple
read.implementation: Tone is printed as a count of one-pixel dots per cell, so density carries the value and nothing is blended; two screens multiplied make the rings.

plates.title: Counted forms
plates.lede: A record drawn in stipple: a twisted strand, a ring of strokes, arcs and counted bars.

read.name: Stipple strand
read.implementation: A ribbon twisted about its axis is filled with dots whose density follows the face turned toward you, one ink per side; the same dots print the bars and arcs.
